reason: I'd run that paper cloud pendant through Google Lens in about a minute and I'm pretty sure I'd find the same shape on Amazon or AliExpress for a fraction of $249. The reviews and the returns policy are nice, but they don't tell me why this one is worth the premium.
objection: I can't judge the quality from photos, and a white paper cloud light looks like a commodity item, so I don't see what I'm paying $249 for over the cheaper lookalikes.
would_change_my_mind: Proof this isn't the generic factory piece, such as a cheap sample of the paper and diffuser, or a side-by-side with the Amazon version showing a real difference in materials and light quality.
